replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
Hey ErPedra.

Thanks for admitting that you hacked but we do not allow this. Just because you said "sorry" and "please give me another chance" doesn't give you an instant ban lift. Please appeal in the next 6-8 months if you are still interested in coming back to the server.

Regards,
Edans
